projects.name: local-wiki
projects.description: A Tauri + React + Rust desktop app that treats a folder of plain GFM markdown files as your knowledge base. Rich TipTap editor, wiki-style [[links]], folder-as-hierarchy navigation, and zero lock-in — your notes stay on disk. Built mostly via an agentic Claude Code workflow.

media.alt: local-wiki editor with sidebar, TipTap editor, and wiki-link suggestion popup
media.caption: Editor with wiki-link autocomplete and folder-as-hierarchy navigation

projects.name: addressable
projects.tagline: Agentic IPAM for multi-project GCP networks
projects.description: Scans all of your GCP projects sharing a 10.0.0.0/8 address space, builds a complete live inventory of allocations, detects 8 classes of CIDR conflicts, and recommends safe CIDRs for new subnets. No database — the source of truth is always live GCP state. Runs as a Claude Code native interface with a standalone CLI fallback.

media.alt: addressable HTML report showing CIDR block utilization and detected conflicts
media.caption: HTML report viewer — block utilization and detected conflicts

projects.name: terraform-modules
projects.tagline: Reusable HCL modules for everyday cloud infra
projects.description: A collection of small, opinionated Terraform modules I reach for across projects — thin wrappers that codify patterns I've found worth standardizing rather than re-deriving each time.

media.code:
module "vpc" {
  source  = "github.com/izz-linux/terraform-modules//aws/vpc"
  name    = "prod"
  cidr    = "10.20.0.0/16"
  azs     = ["us-east-1a", "us-east-1b", "us-east-1c"]
  enable_flow_logs = true
}
